set.body:
Outcome

Certify the scientific wrappers rather than re-testing only raw Resample4s.

Acceptance

- Laws cover identity, composition, multiplicity, exact coverage, nested reconstruction, pairing reversal, population mismatch, and seed stability.
- Negative compile or bind cases prevent capability forgery.
- Deliberately broken wrappers fail the court.
- JVM and Scala.js use reproducible property budgets.
set.title: P3.6: publish design composition, coverage, reconstruction, and seed laws
